---create schmea--
CREATE SCHEMA stg;
GO
CREATE SCHEMA dw;
GO

---create source table--

CREATE TABLE stg.Customer
(
    CustomerID   INT,
    CustomerName NVARCHAR(100),
    City         NVARCHAR(50),
    Email        NVARCHAR(100)
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN, HEAP);

INSERT INTO stg.Customer VALUES (1, 'Amit',  'Pune',   'amit@mail.com');
INSERT INTO stg.Customer VALUES (2, 'Neha',  'Mumbai', 'neha@mail.com');
INSERT INTO stg.Customer VALUES (3, 'Rahul', 'Delhi',  'rahul@mail.com');

select *from stg.Customer


---create datawarehouse table---

CREATE TABLE dw.DimCustomer
(
    CustomerKey   INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,   -- surrogate key
    CustomerID    INT NOT NULL,                 -- business key
    CustomerName  NVARCHAR(100),
    City          NVARCHAR(50),
    Email         NVARCHAR(100),
    LoadDate      DATETIME2,
    UpdatedDate   DATETIME2
)
WITH (DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE, CLUSTERED INDEX (CustomerID));


--- change source table data---
update stg.Customer set city='banglore' where CustomerID=1;
insert into stg.Customer VALUES(4,'priya','nagpur','priya@mail.com');

---chnage scd1 overwrite--

MERGE dw.DimCustomer AS T
USING stg.Customer AS S
ON T.CustomerID = S.CustomerID

WHEN MATCHED
AND (
       ISNULL(T.CustomerName,'') <> ISNULL(S.CustomerName,'')
    OR ISNULL(T.City,'')         <> ISNULL(S.City,'')
    OR ISNULL(T.Email,'')        <> ISNULL(S.Email,'')
)
THEN
    UPDATE SET
        T.CustomerName = S.CustomerName,
        T.City         = S.City,
        T.Email        = S.Email,
        T.UpdatedDate  = GETDATE()

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET
THEN
    INSERT
    (
        CustomerID,
        CustomerName,
        City,
        Email,
        LoadDate,
        UpdatedDate
    )
    VALUES
    (
        S.CustomerID,
        S.CustomerName,
        S.City,
        S.Email,
        GETDATE(),
        GETDATE()
    );
